description: This script manages release review cycles (14+5 day review lifecycle) for components in a repository. It performs actions such as starting, stopping, and clearing review lifecycle dates in metadata.yaml files for specific components, as well as generating reports.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Lists all components by finding metadata.yaml files excluding docs and scripts directories.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays help message with usage instructions and lists available components.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves the path to the metadata.yaml file for a given component, exits if not found.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Calculates a new date by adding a specified number of business days to a given date.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Clears review lifecycle dates in a metadata.yaml file by setting them to a tilde (~).

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Calls an external script to regenerate the RAG status report.
